intro: Blank architecture, guide placement, grip geometry and reel retention influence one another. ASSAULT is being developed as one connected mechanical system.

principles.title: Remove compromise
principles.body: Every part must justify its weight, position and purpose under pressure.

principles.title: Prove the structure
principles.body: Static load, destructive testing and offshore feedback guide decisions.

principles.title: Refine relentlessly
principles.body: Prototype learning is carried forward before production is opened.
